notes: Fig. 8: 'Circuit diagram of a three-stage NMC amplifier' (Lee and Mok, AFFC paper, reference NMC design).
M101/M102: bulk drawn tied to the common source node (tail); recorded as Body=tail.
Crossings without dots read as not connected: M101-drain wire crossing M104 source vertical; Cm1 wire crossing the M200-drain and M202/M203-drain verticals.
M105 is diode connected (gate dot tied to M104/M105 drain node n3); M201 diode connected (gate node tied to M200/M201 drain n4).
Measurement conditions from text: input common-mode voltage 0.3 V; slew tests in unity-gain noninverting configuration with a 0.5-V step. No input sources added.
Inputs listed in label order as printed (Vin-, Vin+); inverting input not decided here.
